SecretSanta.Plan: We will meet at the fountain, then go check out the Christmas markets. We might finish at Pod kamenným stromom, which has its own small Christmas stall with food and drinks.
SecretSanta.ImportantNote: Be on time! For every minute you are late, you will have to send 1 EUR to a charity, a Ukraine support project or something similar.
RuleGroups: It has to be green (Musí to byť zelené)
It has to be red (Musí to byť červené)
It has to be blue (Musí to byť modré)
It has to be yellow (Musí to byť žlté)
It has to be white (Musí to byť biele)
It has to cost between 4,70 EUR and 4,90 EUR (Musí to stáť medzi 4,70 EUR a 4,90 EUR)
It has to sparkle (Musí sa to trblietať)
It has to be soft to the touch (Musí to byť mäkké na dotyk)
It has to weigh more than 1 kg (Musí to vážiť viac ako 1 kg)
It has to weigh less than 200 g (Musí to vážiť menej ako 200 g)
Its name has to start with the letter B (Musí to začínať na písmeno B)
Its name has to start with the letter R (Musí to začínať na písmeno R)
Its name has to start with the letter T (Musí to začínať na písmeno T)
Its name has to start with the letter S (Musí to začínať na písmeno S)
Its name has to start with the letter L (Musí to začínať na písmeno L)
It has to come with a short poem describing the gift (Musí k tomu byť priložená krátka báseň, ktorá darček opisuje)
It has to come with a short poem explaining why you chose this gift (Musí k tomu byť priložená krátka báseň, ktorá vysvetľuje, prečo práve tento darček)

It has to be wrapped in something other than classic wrapping paper – aluminium foil, newspaper, a sock, a milk carton… let your imagination run wild (Musí to byť zabalené v niečom inom ako v klasickom baliacom papieri – alobal, noviny, ponožka, krabica od mlieka… fantázii sa medze nekladú)
It has to be bought in a grocery store, but it must not be edible or drinkable (Musí to byť kúpené v potravinách, ale nesmie sa to dať zjesť ani vypiť)
It has to have a distinctive scent (Musí to mať výraznú vôňu)
